description: Few-shot task examples for the gmail-v1 contract. NOT loaded by the running app (the prompt, cache key and schema are unchanged); reference material to be evaluated in CP4. Emails are the fictional cases L01, L02 and L05 from tests/fixtures/gmail-live-cases.json. All people, addresses and IDs are fictional. Each input is a full prepareInput() input; expectedOutput is the model's gmailSchema result.
